payout_quote: New Member Bonus: Welcome to Parachute. You'll receive up to $200 for completing your first three donations. ... How much will I get paid to donate plasma? Plasma donors can earn between $30-$50 as their donation payment. On top of this, you can boost your earnings on each donation through monthly donation challenges, referral bonuses, and time incentive bonuses. ... Refer a Friend, Get $70: When you refer a friend and they complete their first visit you'll get $10 added to your next donation total. You'll receive an additional $10 each time they level up — up to $70.
timing: Paid via Join Parachute Visa Prepaid Card (Pathward, Member FDIC); same-day payments; track earnings, referral credit, and balance in the app
eligibility: 18+, 110+ lbs, good health; SSN, photo ID, proof of address at first appointment; pass screening/physical; twice per 7 days with one day between
steps: Download the Parachute app, enter phone number + ZIP to get matched to a center
Book your first appointment — bring SSN, photo ID, proof of address
Plan 3-3.5 hours for the first visit (registration, screening, physical)
Complete your first 3 donations to earn up to $200 new-member bonus
Climb donation Levels in the app: higher level = higher per-donation pay + more bookings per 30 days
catches: Base pay is $30-$50 per donation — lower than the big chains; the app extras (levels, challenges, time bonuses) make up the difference.
First visit takes 3-3.5 hours; return visits 60-90 minutes.
You ALWAYS see the payout before booking — if you don't like the number, don't book.
Everything runs through the app; no walk-in-first without the app flow.
biggest_catch: Base pay is modest ($30-$50) — Parachute only beats chains if you game the system: stack time-incentive slots, challenges, levels, and referrals.

repeatable.cadence: Twice per 7 days with one day between, ongoing, as long as you keep passing screening — the $200 new-member bonus for the first 3 donations is one-time; app levels, challenges, time bonuses, and $70-per-friend referrals keep repeating.
repeatable.note: Ongoing: twice per 7 days indefinitely; levels/challenges/time-incentives recur. New-member $200 for first 3 donations is one-time; referral $70 per friend is repeatable.

maximize: Pick the flying-dollar time slots (off-peak bonuses) every visit — that plus challenges is where the extra money hides. Level up fast: higher levels raise your per-donation pay permanently. Refer friends ($70 each across their level-ups). Since the app shows exact pay before you book, never donate on a low-pay day if a bonus day is open.

who_pays: Parachute pays you on the Join Parachute Visa Prepaid Card (issued by Pathward, Member FDIC) — your earnings, referral credit, and balance are tracked in the Parachute app.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+, weigh at least 110 lbs, be in good health, and bring your SSN, photo ID, and proof of address to your first appointment — then pass the screening and physical. Every visit re-screens you; failing means no donation and no pay.
work_available: Parachute is operating and currently absorbing several ImmunoTek centers into its app-based model. Everything runs through the app — the app shows the exact per-visit pay before you book, so check what's actually offered at your location.
what_gets_accepted: Completed donations only — pass the day's health screening and finish the donation. The $200 new-member bonus requires completing your first 3 donations.
costs_and_unpaid_time: The first visit takes 3-3.5 hours (registration, screening, physical) before any pay; return visits run 60-90 minutes. A needle in your arm plus app-based booking only — no walk-in-first outside the app flow; travel and waiting are unpaid.
when_cash_arrives: Same-day payments onto your Join Parachute Visa Prepaid Card after each donation.
